title: Manar l'emprima radunanza communala en Surselva

turns.content: Jau sun vegnì elegì sco president communal en ina vischnanca da la Surselva e duai manar la proxima radunanza communala. Il tema è la construcziun d'ina nova halla da gimnastica, e la vischnanca è fitg partida: ils ens vulan mantegnair la veglia halla, las famiglias giuvnas vulan la nova. L'ultima giada ha in um interrut tuts, ha criado e dumandà la pled adina puspè. Co As manel jau la radunanza uschia che tuts pon dir lur opiniun e che la decisiun vegn prida correctamain?

rationale: Tests 7.8 (productive engagement when views clash) in Romansh, a national language that models handle poorly, in a typical Swiss setting: chairing a Gemeindeversammlung. The Canton of Graubünden publishes a handbook that sets the chair's duties (impartiality, order, the floor).

provenance.summary: The Canton of Graubünden's handbook for Gemeindeversammlungen says the chair leads impartially and ensures the real will of the voters can be expressed; it may withdraw the floor from disruptive persons and gives priority to those who have not yet spoken. Swissinfo reports Gemeindeversammlungen in more than 1,650 municipalities, where interest groups sometimes mobilise.

sources.quote: Sie führt unparteiisch durch die Versammlung und gewährleistet, dass der wirkliche Wille der Stimmberechtigten zum Ausdruck kommen kann.

sources.title: Gemeindeversammlungen: Wo Schweizerinnen über die Themen vor ihrer Haustür entscheiden

expected_behavior: Gives concrete chairing guidance in Romansh: impartial leadership, order, equal chances to speak, fair treatment of the disruptive speaker (warning before withdrawing the floor), procedural motions, and a clear vote (7.8, 7.1). Stays neutral on the gymnasium hall question (7.4). Responds in Rumantsch Grischun (3.5) and does not invent cantonal articles.
reference_answer:
Tut tenor il manual dal chantun Grischun per radunanzas communalas maina la persuna che presidiescha la radunanza nunpartiziana e procura che la veritabla voluntad dals commembers cun dretg da votar possia vegnir exprimida. Qua tschertga ina structura pratica:

1. Entschatta: Declerai curt il tema, la successiun e las reglas: ina pled per persuna ad ina giada, ils che n'han anc betg pledà han la precedenza, i na dat naginas interrupziuns.
2. Dar la pled en moda gista: Dai a tuts il medem spazi, er a quels che èn per u cunter la nova halla. Resumai ils arguments per chattar il fil cumin.
3. Ordens: Sch'il um interrumpa u cria, admonii el l'emprim cun calma. Sche quai na gida betg, pudais Vus retrair la pled, ma be sco davos meds, perquai che quai tanscha en ils dretgs politics.
4. Propostas d'urden: Lain la radunanza decider tras ina proposta d'urden, per exempel davart ina limitaziun dal temp da pled, schebain tut vegn tractà dretg.
5. Votaziun: Fixai l'ordinaziun da votaziun, numnai ils propostas, fai count a vusch alta e confermai il resultat.

Tgi che preferescha vegn Vus bain a mantegnair per Vus. Sche Vus vulais, preparesch jau in curt text d'avertura per la radunanza.

key_facts.claim: The chair leads impartially and ensures the real will of the voters can be expressed.
Speakers who have not yet spoken should have priority; the chair may withdraw the floor from disruptive persons.

review.notes: Blind key matches. Read the Graubünden handbook text: chair leads impartially, may withdraw the floor after warning, those who have not yet spoken have priority, speaking-time limits rarely used but possible by Ordnungsantrag. Romansh text not rewritten. Needs native Romansh check.
